name: What type of paint should I choose for my home's interior?

mainEntity.name: What type of paint should I choose for my home's interior?

acceptedAnswer.text: Choosing the right paint involves considering durability, finish, and specific room needs. Latex (water-based) paints are popular for interiors due to their easy cleanup and low VOCs. For high-traffic areas like hallways or kitchens, consider durable eggshell or satin finishes. Matte or flat finishes are ideal for ceilings or low-traffic rooms as they hide imperfections well. We can help you select the best paint type and finish based on your lifestyle and aesthetic preferences.
acceptedAnswer.description: Select paint based on durability, finish, and room use. Latex paints are common; eggshell/satin are durable for high-traffic areas, while matte/flat suit low-traffic rooms.
